map.输入断面宽度、扁平比、轮辋直径，计算轮胎直径、周长、每公里转数，并推荐速度等级。: Enter section width, aspect ratio and rim diameter to compute tire diameter, circumference and revolutions per kilometre, and get a speed-rating recommendation.
map.轮胎直径 = 轮辋直径 × 25.4 + 2 × 断面宽度 × 扁平比 ÷ 10: Tire diameter = rim diameter × 25.4 + 2 × section width × aspect ratio ÷ 100 (mm). For example 225/55R17: 17 × 25.4 + 2 × 225 × 0.55 = 431.8 + 247.5 = 679.3 mm. Circumference = π × diameter, and revolutions per km = 1000000 ÷ circumference.
map.直径偏差建议控制在 ±3% 以内，超出会使速度表与里程表明显失真，还可能干涉轮拱: Keep diameter deviation within ±3%; beyond that the speedometer and odometer drift noticeably and the tire may foul the wheel arch or upset ABS/ESP calibration. Prefer "wider with a lower profile" to keep overall diameter near standard, and check wheel ET offset against tire width for interference.
map.💡 换胎后速度表偏差按比例产生：表显速度 ×（新周长 ÷ 原周长）≈ 实际速度。: 💡 After a tire change the speedometer error is proportional: indicated speed × (new circumference ÷ original circumference) ≈ actual speed. Recalibrate or convert mentally when the error is significant.
map.📚 深度解析：车速与轮胎限速等级匹配: 📚 In-depth: Matching Vehicle Speed to Tire Speed Rating
map.选轮胎时核对限速指数是否满足车辆最高车速，避免高速爆胎风险。: When choosing tires, confirm the speed rating covers the vehicle's top speed to avoid high-speed blowout risk.
map.改装升级轮毂后核算轮胎周长变化对表显速度与实际速度的影响。: After upgrading wheels, work out how the changed circumference shifts indicated versus actual speed.
map.跑高速或赛道日前确认轮胎速度级别余量。: Confirm tire speed-rating headroom before sustained high-speed runs or track days.
map.225/55R17 的直径 = 17 × 25.4 + 2 × 225 × 55: 225/55R17 gives a diameter of 17 × 25.4 + 2 × 225 × 55 ÷ 100 = 431.8 + 247.5 = 679.3 mm, circumference = π × 679.3 ≈ 2134.1 mm and about 468.6 revolutions per kilometre. The original 215/55R17 measures 668.3 mm, so the change is +1.65%, inside the ±3% tolerance, yet the speedometer still errs in proportion to circumference: an indicated 100 km/h is really about 101.6 km/h. With a top speed of 230 km/h you need at least a V-rated (240 km/h) tire.
map.限速指数不够会怎样？: What happens if the speed rating is too low?
map.持续超速等级行驶轮胎升温加剧、结构疲劳，高速易爆胎。必须选等于或高于厂家指定指数: Running continuously above the rated speed heats the tire and fatigues its structure, raising the risk of a high-speed blowout. Always pick the manufacturer's specified index or higher.
map.改轮毂为何速度表不准？: Why does changing wheels make the speedometer wrong?
map.表显基于原厂轮胎周长，换不同周长轮胎后每圈行驶距离变了，实际速度与表显产生固定比: The speedometer is calibrated to the original tire circumference; once the circumference differs, distance per revolution changes and a fixed proportional error appears between actual and indicated speed, needing recalibration or acceptance of the error.
map.直径偏差建议控制在 ±3% 以内；改装后速度表与里程表会按周长比例产生固定误差: Keep diameter deviation within ±3%; after modification the speedometer and odometer carry a fixed error proportional to circumference
